claims.claim: Seven to nine percent gross rental yields in Kampala
claims.reason: Evidence map states 7 to 9 percent, but script rounds down to 7, omitting the upper bound of 9.

claims.claim: growing at over five percent a year
claims.reason: Evidence map specifies 'urbanising at over 5% a year', but the script vaguely claims the city is 'growing' at this rate, conflating urbanization rate with general growth.

claims.claim: Uganda's population sits near fifty million
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('nearly 50 million people').

claims.claim: A two bedroom apartment in Kira or Najjera typically costs between seventy and ninety-five thousand dollars
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('70 to 95 thousand US dollars').

claims.claim: a seven to nine percent gross return
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('7 to 9 percent gross').

claims.claim: Under the nineteen ninety-five Constitution, foreigners cannot hold freehold title to land in Uganda.
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('The 1995 Constitution, Article 237').

claims.claim: The law does allow a leasehold of up to ninety-nine years
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('leasehold — up to 99 years').

claims.claim: the Condominium Property Act of two thousand one
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('Condominium Property Act of 2001').

claims.claim: title fraud is endemic
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('Title fraud is endemic').

claims.claim: the land registry's computerisation has moved at a glacial pace.
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('land registry's computerisation has been glacial').

claims.claim: Stamp duty is one percent of the purchase price
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('Stamp duty: 1 percent on transfer').

claims.claim: as a buyer you must withhold six percent of the gross price as an advance tax on the seller.
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('buyer must withhold 6 percent of the gross purchase price').

claims.claim: professional property management typically eats eight percent of the rent
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('property management at about 8 percent').

claims.claim: a realistic vacancy allowance for mid market units is another eight percent.
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('vacancy allowance of about 8 percent').

claims.claim: On a gross rent of eight hundred dollars a month, those two costs alone cut your gross yield by more than one-sixth before the tax man arrives.
claims.reason: The specific '$800 a month' figure and the 'one-sixth' calculation are introduced in the script and are completely absent from the evidence map.

claims.claim: The Uganda Revenue Authority levies a rental income tax of twelve percent on gross annual rent
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('Rental income tax: 12 percent of gross annual rent').

claims.claim: if you sell, a capital gains tax of thirty percent applies to the profit.
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('Capital gains tax sits at 30 percent of the gain').

claims.claim: Uganda also asserts the right to tax its residents on worldwide income
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('Uganda asserts the right to tax your worldwide income').

claims.claim: The Revenue Authority has been actively pursuing diaspora owners and high net worth individuals for undeclared offshore income
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('Uganda Revenue Authority has recently been actively pursuing diaspora and high-net-worth individuals over undeclared offshore income').

claims.claim: Seven to nine percent gross yields collapse to roughly four to six percent
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('net yield of roughly 4 to 6 percent').

claims.claim: the net dollar return lands between five and nine percent per year in a good outcome
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('net dollar return lands somewhere in the range of 5 to 9 percent per year in a good outcome').

claims.claim: the shilling's gradual depreciation, which runs at historically low single digits each year.
claims.reason: Supported by evidence map ('shilling's slow, quiet depreciation — historically low single digits per year').

claims.claim: yields hover around three or four percent
claims.reason: The claim regarding developed market yields is an unverified comparison introduced in the script and not found in the evidence map.
